metadata.name: investscape-research-library
metadata.description: Member-only browsing of manually approved Research summaries and source links.

specifications: Requires an explicitly registered Research session host; does not discover or modify Auth plugins.
No editor-mode requests, automatic loading, writes, full text, localStorage or direct database access.
Clears visible content after at most 30 seconds, when the tab hides, on host invalidation or runtime-property change.
Clears old results before requesting replacements; content is rendered as escaped text.
Inherits surrounding typography/colors; source dates remain unknown when not supplied.
